t.p: Immerse yourself in unmatched luxury along the golden sands of the Bay of Bengal. Every corner of the suite is appointed with high-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens, bespoke teakwood furniture from Coastal Andhra artisans, a private balcony with sea breezes, and an ambient marble bathroom.
Guests enjoy 24/7 dedicated butler assistance, high-speed Wi-Fi, and priority reservations at our award-winning Baywatch Coastal Restaurant.
